newsitem.title: USA: Head of swaps and derivatives association resigns.
newsitem.headline: Head of swaps and derivatives association resigns.

text.p: International Swaps and Derivatives Association said Thursday its executive director, Carolyn Jackson, had resigned to pursue personal interests.

"After 15 years of my professional life in financial derivatives, and contemplating the next 15, I realize that I now want to pursue a different path," Jacskon said in a statement. "I have decided that the time has come to carry out my long-time interest in writing."
Jackson, formerly in charge of the derivatives products trading desk at Banque Indosuez, had served as director of the group since March 1995. --Aaron Pressman((202-898-8312))
